change: Remove changed-input review flags, warnings, recording steps and finalisation requirements in component and legacy workspaces.

browser: Standalone release 2.0.5 opens with no changed-input warning or selection-review controls.
Changing a Foundation budget and applying a solver recommendation updates all dependent audience coverage and learner time without review-required badges.
The edited component plan finalises directly without recording any component or audience reviews.
A legacy schema-2 plan with needsReview=true imports, persists across reload, and opens its cohort path without a warning or review button.
The flagged legacy plan finalises directly without a recorded review.
No browser console warnings or errors.

compatibility: Existing review metadata is ignored and retained on JSON roundtrip. Coverage, recommendation invalidation, catalogue/model identity and reference validation remain active.
limitations: Direct file:// opening and native print/PDF layout were not checked.
